question: During the British rule, who was the first Inspector General of Forests in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dietrich Brandis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sir Dietrich Brandis** was a German-British botanist, forestry professor, and administrator who spent over 30 years with the British Imperial Forestry Service in colonial India.
 
• Brandis was appointed **Inspector General of Forests in India in 1864,** a position he held for 20 years.
